candidate_only_subrun.baseline_join: identity and rms_fixed are immutable reference rows pinned by row IDs in the full common-support control ledger

execution.baseline_join_policy: identity and RMS each retain their own generated-video and score-matrix hashes; pair support requires exact original PCM, source face/video, seed, model, scorer/preprocessing, FPS, frame/query clock, lag array and valid-mask agreement. No cross-method video/matrix hash or distance-value equality is required.
execution.scope: development only; 20 fixed Dev clips × 3 frozen seeds × 3 qualified native frontends

frame_count_semantics.count_source: native audio.melspectrogram(wav2lip.audio.load_wav(frozen_natural_wav, 16000)) then AST-executed exact pinned inference.py mel chunk block
frame_count_semantics.future_duration_contract: bind per-sample expected_inference_frame_count to the frozen same-length candidate generator PCM; transform contract preserves sample_count
frame_count_semantics.static_image_output_mapping: one yielded mel chunk maps to one datagen frame and one VideoWriter frame; both loops were checked from the exact pinned inference.py AST

git_revision: local-uncommitted-stagea-executor; see stageA source SHA in result manifest

config.peak_policy: use the exact frozen V3 CLI constructor; reject any configured peak violation without clipping/post-gain
config.score_audio: exact original natural PCM16 source under the frozen native evaluator

methods.selection_scope: fixed terminal fit step 120; weights frozen before Dev and not chosen using Dev; confirmation remains closed

generator.implementation: official pinned inference.py entry with strict runtime compatibility hooks; source-derived frame-count binding per natural PCM

profile.face_box: single fixed source portrait; OpenCV Haar frontalface_default; one expanded square bbox shared for model crop and composite
profile.face_parser: MuseTalk official FaceParsing BiSeNet with pinned parser and ResNet18 weights
profile.official_frame_resize: uint8 cv2.resize INTER_LINEAR to expanded face bbox dimensions
profile.source_clock: natural PCM frame clock at 25 fps; no retiming

profile.face_mode: fixed primary static portrait; model-native face preparation, no moving source video
profile.onnxruntime_profile: four auxiliary ONNX sessions explicitly use CPUExecutionProvider
profile.source_clock: 25/1 frame timestamps start at zero and follow source_clock_frame_index/25; no time warp; keep every fresh renderer output frame
profile.torch_profile: pinned Torch 2.5.1+cu124 renderer on RTX 4080 SUPER

audio.resampling: AISHELL source already mono/16k; no resampling

generator.face_input: same pinned primary static portrait for all dev rows/methods/seeds
generator.source_video_role: shared static portrait reference; Wav2Lip consumes source_face image directly

roi.query_frame_map: crop-local evaluator query row i maps through selected_track_crop.frame_map to source_clock_frame_index on the nominal original 25-fps clock; render_frame_index may be null for nominal clock rows outside decoded render
